limitations: Existing durable qualifiers only, sequential isolated browsers. No production or harness changes are made by this wrapper. Each selected job runs once; a strict failure remains failed while later independent jobs may proceed only after confirmed browser/server cleanup.

Some durable qualifiers retain empty-stack pageerrors as empty strings; any pageerror still fails their strict count. Raw/name diagnostics require a separate bounded probe after preserving such a failed receipt.
Classic checks cover metadata union and three real selected base/current/archive performances per engine, not all 240 complete performances again.
The two-hour actual-wall-time rotation and outstanding physical-device/human review checks remain separate.
